URGENCY.explanation: The message pressures you to act fast — phrases like "act now" or "within 24 hours" are designed to stop you from thinking it through.

THREAT.friendlyName: Threatens to block or suspend your account
THREAT.explanation: Real banks don't threaten to freeze your account over a text or email. This is a common scare tactic.

SENSITIVE_REQUEST.explanation: Banks never ask you to share your OTP, PIN, password, or full card number through a message — not even "to verify your identity".

SUSPICIOUS_LINK.explanation: The link uses an unusual address or a link-shortener that hides where it really goes. Genuine bank links use the bank's official domain.

IMPERSONATION.friendlyName: Pretends to be from your bank
IMPERSONATION.explanation: The message mentions your bank by name, but combined with the other warning signs here, it's likely impersonating us rather than actually being from us.

exampleMessages.label: A normal OTP message
exampleMessages.text: Your OTP for login is 482910. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone, including bank staff. - PSB

exampleMessages.label: A "verify your account" message
exampleMessages.text: Dear Customer, your account requires re-verification. Please update your KYC details to continue using our services without interruption.

exampleMessages.label: An urgent "account suspended" message
exampleMessages.text: URGENT: Your bank account will be suspended in 24 hours! Click here immediately to verify your account and avoid permanent block: http://psb-secure-verify.tk/login
